page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorated capital, read here as E (joined to "Rat" as "ERat"); the letter is not fully clear, so it is a probable reading. The word "peregrinare / tur" is broken at the line end without a printed hyphen and is written whole. The first line of the sermon's continuation has a dot-like mark in "f.cies", read as "facies". Abbreviations itaq; and quoq; are kept as printed. The heading "Genef. 12." is printed with the long-s form and is copied as "Genes. 12." with the s normalised.
